mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows tasks to be created without a creator, violating the core authentication requirement (FR-001). The injection forces a task with no creator to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthenticatedTask { some t: Task | no t.created_by }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact leaves the permission matrix unconstrained. The injection forces it to be empty, breaking the invariant that authenticated members have access to all operations (FR-003, FR-004).
Removing this fact allows tasks to exist without creation or update timestamps, violating the requirement that all tasks track these timestamps (FR-017).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingTimestamp { some t: Task | no t.created_at }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows deletion logs to have incomplete information (missing deleter, timestamp, etc.), violating the requirement that all deletion events are fully recorded (FR-018).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_IncompleteDeleteLog { some td: TaskDeletion | no td.deleted_by }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows tasks to have invalid status values. While Alloy's type system limits status to valid values, this fact explicitly enforces the constraint for clarity.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidStatus { some t: Task | t.status != none and t.status not in (Todo + InProgress + Done) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a task's creator field to reference a non-existent member, violating the invariant that all attribution must resolve to actual workspace members.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidCreator { some t: Task | t.created_by != none and t.created_by not in Member }
